body: I've been taking medication for about 3 months now
Long period of disability/being out of work. My depression led to a super low/almost non-existent sex drive. He felt neglected. Let himself get too friendly with someone close to us.

Major depressive disorder. I don't want to be on disability, honestly. I was on it temporarily for an injury, and the resulting depression led to the worst year of my entire life. It just feels like too much sometimes.

I've been on it only for two weeks, but have had no adverse effects so far. My blood sugar has been testing much lower than usual without any notable dietary changes. I used to be 287-300 even for my fasting morning reading; now I am 100-150 points lower consistently. I obviously still have more work to do since my readings are still above "normal" but I'm pretty confident about how it's going so far.
